name: Nalar Workplace Brain
description: Jawab pertanyaan karyawan dari chat, drive, task board, dan HRIS dengan kontrol akses per identitas dan sitasi wajib.
description_zh: 基于权限的企业知识助手，跨聊天、云盘、任务板与 HRIS 回答员工问题，并强制引用来源。
description_en: Access-controlled workplace answers across chat, drive, task boards, and HRIS with mandatory citations.
examples_zh: 我一年有多少天带薪年假？
Acme 合同的金额是多少？
昨天 Atlas 的结账故障原因是什么？
examples_en: How many paid annual leave days do I get?
What is the Acme contract value?
What caused yesterday's Atlas checkout failure?
